intent.raw: Create a dispatch-backed strategy so Refine can inspect everything still missing for Craft, surface blockers and gaps for decision, build the follow-on work, and run a first live test.
intent.objective: Prepare a validator-backed local skill-surface strategy for completing Craft's remaining receipt-backed refinement path without promoting Craft or using the retired command surface as execution authority.
intent.operator_sentence: refine everything that is still missing for craft, get all blockers and gaps so we can decide, build it after, and do first live test

route_menu.context_hint: Craft is already architected locally; the first missing blocker is Interrogation refine-review owner-stage receipt evidence.

items.label: Local receipt sequence
items.description: Continue the existing Refine run by creating local owner-stage receipts in dependency order.

items.label: Promotion review
items.description: Attempt to decide canonical promotion now. This is rejected because Craft promotion remains deferred.

technique_overlays.trigger: Craft's latest run has receipt-backed Context Builder and Invoke Define stages, but Interrogation refine-review remains the first blocked owner stage.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each owner-stage pass must cite a receipt file, owner artifact path, validation result, and downstream blocker update before the next stage is attempted.

technique_overlays.trigger: The user asked to build after deciding and do the first live test.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Run one bounded live Craft scenario against the resulting plan and record pass, flag, or block without promoting Craft.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The missing-gap sweep spans architecture evidence, receipt evidence, runtime boundary evidence, and promotion readiness.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound sibling agents can inspect separate evidence lanes without mixing authority: one for Craft product gaps, one for Refine receipt continuity, one for runtime/local-skill boundary drift, and one for validation/live-test readiness.
context: development/craft/SESSION-LEDGER.md names Interrogation refine-review as the next missing receipt.
development/craft/CRAFT-INVOKE-DEFINE-STAGE-RECEIPT-REFRESH-REPORT.md retires command-surface routing for the active workflow.

roles.purpose: Inspect run evidence and list remaining owner-stage receipts in dependency order.
Inspect Craft architecture, validation examples, readiness review, and ledger artifacts for remaining non-runtime gaps.
roles.owns: Craft product and method gap lane

roles.purpose: Check that local skill execution, generated command-surface history, and promotion boundaries are not conflated.
Define the smallest live Craft scenario that can validate the completed missing-gap plan.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve spawning four local role-bound subagents for the Craft missing-gap sweep before executing the full Refine run?
receipt_requirements: Each subagent returns files inspected, blockers found, gaps found, recommended next route, and confidence.
No subagent mutates canonical registry, runtime, sigil, spell, or promotion surfaces.
All claims cite concrete local paths.

steps.name: Current Craft evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if Craft README, SESSION-LEDGER, or latest evidence-index cannot be read.

steps.name: Stale blocker repair gate
stop_conditions: Flag if the stage file still says Invoke Define is missing after evidence-index says Invoke Define has receipt-backed pass evidence.

steps.name: Strategy preview and permission checkpoint

outputs.ref: approval to run full missing-gap Refine sweep with recommended subagents

stop_conditions: Stop before subagent fanout until the operator approves the role-bound strategy.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review owner receipt
stop_conditions: Write a block receipt instead of proceeding if Interrogation cannot produce owner-stage evidence.

steps.name: Research decision refresh

outputs.ref: research mode for remaining Craft missing-gap sweep

stop_conditions: Ask before external research if local evidence is insufficient.

steps.name: Remaining blockers and gaps x-ray
stop_conditions: Block if blockers cannot be tied to concrete paths or owner capabilities.

steps.name: Smallest coherent completion unit

outputs.ref: minimum Craft completion unit and rejected alternatives

stop_conditions: Flag if the selected unit cannot recompose into the full Craft readiness target.

steps.name: Craft missing-work design refresh
stop_conditions: Do not redesign completed Craft architecture unless S5 proves a concrete gap.

steps.name: Design critique and repair gate
stop_conditions: Return to S7 if review finds a block-level design defect.

steps.name: Non-executed build plan
stop_conditions: Do not execute build tasks until task-session receives an explicit ready work-pack task.

steps.name: Decision synthesis
stop_conditions: Ask the operator before building any nontrivial implementation or promotion task.

steps.name: First live test
stop_conditions: Run only the first ready task selected by the approved work-pack.
Block instead of mutating if no ready task exists.

gates.condition: Craft remains candidate-local; no registry, ontology, inventory, sigil, spell, or canonical runtime promotion happens in this strategy.
Active execution uses local skill surfaces and concrete local artifact receipts; command-surface history is evidence only.
Subagent fanout and full missing-gap Refine execution require explicit operator approval after strategy preview.
No downstream stage is marked pass without an owner artifact, receipt, and validation result.
Build execution and first live test happen only after the blocker/gap decision pack is reviewed.

boundaries.contract: Interrogation owns critique artifacts and must return an owner-stage artifact plus receipt before Refine marks the stage pass.
The first live test returns task-session evidence and does not become canonical Craft promotion evidence without review.
Writes stay under development/craft/ and run evidence folders unless a later reviewed plan changes scope.

authority.memory: observability ledger only; no memory promotion from this dispatch

state_namespaces.write_policy: candidate-local source and planning artifacts only
stage evidence, receipts, manifests, and results only
generated telemetry and reflection state only

promotion_splits.rule: Evidence can inform promotion review but cannot directly promote canonical knowledge; explicit owner review is required.

promotion_guardrails: Craft remains under development/craft/ until explicit promotion review.
Execution evidence may inform but cannot directly change canonical sigil, spell, registry, runtime, ontology, inventory, or glossary authority.
The strategy may prepare a build plan and first live test, but build execution requires a ready task-session task and operator decision.
